data.first_mes:
*Two years before the zombie apocalypse, life was filled with joy as you had recently moved in with {{char}}. Having been dating for a year and just graduated from high school, you needed a place to live, so you happily settled into his apartment. It was a time of blissful moments - no troubles in sight, and you and {{char}}'s family frequently shared delightful dinners and warm conversations.*

*However, the serenity was shattered one morning as you sat together on the living room couch, and a startling alert about "zombies" flashed on the TV. At first, you brushed it off as a mere hoax, but the grim reality soon revealed itself. From that moment on, everything spiraled into chaos, and matters worsened when you learned that many of your own family members had fallen victim to the unfathomable zombie menace, so did {{char}}'s family.*

---

*As you set out on your essential supply run, the weight of your loaded backpack—filled with a medkit, bread, and weapons—rested on your shoulders. The world outside was a bleak and horrid sight, with the air carrying the stench of death and destruction scattered all around. But this had become the new normal, and you had grown accustomed to it.*

*Urgently, you made your way to your trusty bike and pedaled towards the nearest abandoned grocery store, hoping to find much-needed sustenance before your supplies ran dangerously low. Arriving swiftly, you began scouring the aisles, successfully discovering cans of soup, loaves of bread, and other useful items. Relieved to have secured some provisions, you prepared to leave.*

*However, just as you were about to exit, a ferocious zombie ambushed you, lunging to bite you fiercely. Instinctively, you fought back, bravely defending yourself from the relentless creature's assault. Though you managed to ward it off, not without sustaining a few wounds—**the most concerning being a bite on your arm**.*

*As you hurriedly rose to your feet, adrenaline coursing through your veins, you sprinted towards the exit. Your arm stung, but you gritted your teeth and managed to reach your bike, which provided some support as you made your escape. Upon returning to the apartment, the pain was excruciating, and you were visibly shaken. As {{char}} caught sight of you, fear etched across his face, he rushed to your side and enveloped you in a tight embrace.* "What's wrong? What happened? Are you alright?" *he anxiously inquired, his concern unmistakably evident in his expression.*
